Base pay range ₹1,000,000.00/yr - ₹2,000,000.00/yr Job Description We are looking for an experienced Webflow designer and developer at our company, Mistura, to take ownership of the entire creative and technical side of our web communications. You will not only build sophisticated websites yourself but also establish the structures, processes and quality standards for the entire team. You will report directly to the European management team of Mistura and its content creators and take responsibility for the professional development of a young team in Bengaluru, India, consisting of two UX designers who already have initial experience with Webflow. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Webflow Design and Development: - Take overall responsibility for the design, technical implementation and quality of our websites. - Build and maintain responsive, production-ready websites in Webflow. - Translate Figma designs into pixel-accurate, animation-rich Webflow experiences. - Create well-structured CMS architectures with collections, dynamic content and reusable components. - Develop micro-animations, scroll-based interactions, hover effects and page transitions. - Use Webflow's native features as well as GSAP, Lottie and custom code where required. - Integrate third-party tools, external APIs, forms, CRM systems and analytics solutions. - Set up and maintain multilingual websites. - Optimise performance, SEO, accessibility and user experience. - Maintain, troubleshoot and continuously improve existing websites. Team Leadership and Project Management: - Provide professional and day-to-day leadership for two UX designers. - Support the team's development in web design, UX and Webflow. - Coordinate the handover from Figma to Webflow. - Plan and manage projects, timelines, deliverables and quality standards. - Run regular check-ins and stand-up meetings. - Help the team overcome technical and organisational challenges. - Coordinate with other involved teams. - Report project status, timelines and risks directly to the European management team. - Document design, handover and Webflow development standards. Requirements: - Minimum 3 years of hands-on Webflow development experience (CMS, interactions/animations, responsive design, custom code). - Excellent understanding of layout, typography, responsive design, UX and visual quality. - Confident use of Figma and experience translating designs into Webflow. - Experience with Webflow CMS, interactions and reusable components. - Technical understanding of custom code, integrations and APIs. - A structured, independent and solution-oriented way of working. - Willingness to take ownership and go the extra mile when required. - Motivation to share knowledge and develop a team professionally. - Bachelor's degree in any technical stream (BTech / BE / equivalent). - Good written and spoken English. - German language skills are an advantage but are explicitly not required. Company Summary Mistura Software Technologies, India, is a subsidiary of Industry Fusion based in Bayern, Germany. We are one of the first and strongest supporters and partners of the IndustryFusion project, together with Intel, SUSE, IONOS, Sopra Steria, Microstep Europe, and many more. IndustryFusion is a top-level open-source project that addresses open, manufacturer-independent, and interoperable networking in industry in Europe. IndustryFusion covers components, machines, materials, personnel, and all other areas of a smart factory, such as building control, and enables deployment in the edge or the cloud. Based on the long-standing and close collaboration between mechanical and plant manufacturers, component manufacturers, software developers, and representatives from science and politics in the Industry Business Network 4.0 eV association, the IndustryFusion Foundation was founded on July 27 2020 in St. Gallen (Switzerland). Through open standards and reference implementations (open source), the Foundation creates the basis for the digitalization and networking of European industry covering over 80,000 companies in machine manufacturing and ensures its constant further development. How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities) Job Summary This role is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of full‑stack applications and shared platform services deployed on AWS. The position operates as a senior contributor within the team, combining hands‑on development with strong engineering practices, test automation awareness, and operational excellence. The Senior Full Stack Developer will work closely with product, platform, QE, and operations teams to deliver scalable, secure, and observable solutions. While the primary focus is full‑stack development, the role requires practical exposure to automation testing, dashboards, analytics, and cloud‑native DevOps patterns to support data‑driven decision making and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Demonstrated experience using AWS AI/ML services such as Amazon SageMaker, Bedrock, and AgentCore. Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro) to accomplish tasks such as generating and reviewing code, writing and maintaining tests, creating documentation, and debugging, while exercising sound judgment to validate and take ownership of AI-generated output. Understanding of prompt engineering, AI workflows, and/or model integration patterns. Design, develop, and maintain cloud‑native full‑stack applications using modern frontend and backend technologies, with a focus on clean, maintainable, secure, and well‑documented code. Build and consume RESTful APIs and microservices deployed on AWS, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance. Participate across the entire application lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Collaborate with architects, product owners, QE, and other developers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. Contribute to automation testing efforts, including development and maintenance of unit, API, integration, and contract tests to ensure high code quality and regression coverage. Support the development and integration of dashboards and analytics to provide visibility into application health, operational metrics, and system usage. Participate in CI/CD pipeline development and maintenance, enabling automated builds, tests, deployments, and quality gates. Apply DevSecOps best practices, including secure coding standards, dependency management, and proactive risk identification. Assist with steady‑state operations, troubleshooting production issues, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure applications are optimized for performance, scalability, and mobile‑friendly UI/UX where applicable. Participate in code reviews, promoting best practices, coding standards, and knowledge sharing within the team. Analyze problems effectively, provide accurate effort estimates, and deliver milestones within committed timelines. Create and maintain technical documentation covering design, deployment, operational procedures, and troubleshooting. Collaborate with global teams across time zones to support delivery, integration, and operational objectives. What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Minimum 5 years of IT experience with strong hands‑on full‑stack software development experience. Solid understanding of modern application architectures, including microservices and API‑driven systems. Experience with frontend development using Angular, React, or similar frameworks. Backend development experience using Java, TypeScript or Python. Hands‑on experience with AWS cloud services, including compute, storage, networking, and monitoring. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git‑based source control platforms (GitHub, GitLab, or similar). Working knowledge of automated testing frameworks and practices (unit, API, integration testing). Familiarity with dashboards and analytics concepts, including application metrics and operational reporting. Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross‑functional teams. Consistent commitment to safety, security, and protection of customer and organizational data. Behavioral Competencies Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach. Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively. Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships. Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends. Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions. What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications) Experience in designing, building, and deploying multi‑layered application architectures across on‑premises and AWS cloud environments using services such as EC2, ECS, S3, VPC, RDS, SQS, ELB, Auto Scaling, CloudFront, CloudFormation, ElastiCache, CloudWatch, and SNS. Strong understanding of cloud computing models (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS) and hands‑on implementation experience using AWS and container platforms such as OpenShift. Experience implementing and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodeCommit, CodePipeline, or equivalent Git‑based CI/CD platforms.Proficiency across multiple frontend and backend technologies, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular or React, Java, Python, and Node.js. Experience developing and maintaining test automation tools and frameworks for unit, contract, API, integration, and web/UI testing. Hands‑on experience working in Agile delivery environments, supporting multiple applications and releases. Proven ability to set up and maintain CI pipelines for new branches and releases while ensuring stability, dependency management, and seamless integration with existing pipelines. Exposure to resolving build, deployment, and dependency issues in complex, enterprise‑scale systems. Curiosity to learn new technologies and continuously improve engineering practices. About The Company What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U.S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service. Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good. In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor’s 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience. About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program. For more information, please visit www.deltatechhub.com Why join? Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience. Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs -exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships. Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture. Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions. Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme Show more Show less Seniority level Not Applicable Employment type Full-time Industries Airlines and Aviation Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Delta Technology Hub by 2x See who you know
